lead: Objects owned for worship, devotion, divination and mourning, browsed first by faith or craft tradition (Christian, Jewish, Islamic, Hindu-Sikh-Jain, Buddhist, Shinto-Daoist-Chinese folk), then shared ritual goods, tarot and divination, and funeral goods.

depts.note: Catholic, Orthodox and Protestant devotional and liturgical objects; craft traditions (icon schools, santos, Oberammergau and Val Gardena carving) recorded in the tradition register.

b.m: Form and style for the rite
b.v: standing, Tau and St Benedict crosses; five-decade, one-decade and finger rosaries
b.w: Crosses, statues and beads are chosen by the form the devotion needs.

b.v: hand-painted or carved > cast or printed

b.w: Where it was made; a label only, never a ranking.

s.brief: Archetypes: crucifix forms (Latin, San Damiano, Tau, St Benedict, Orthodox three-bar, Celtic); icon types (Hodegetria, Eleousa e.g. Vladimir Mother of God, Pantocrator, Theotokos of Kazan) with schools (Byzantine, Russian Palekh/Mstera, Cretan); statue traditions (Val Gardena/Ortisei, Oberammergau, Spanish santos, Philippine santos, Fontanini/Neapolitan presepe for nativities). Relics keep the first/second/third-class ladder as types. Add tradition entries for icon painting, Val Gardena carving, Neapolitan presepe, santos. No SKU lists.

k.brief: Painted or printed panel icons; Orthodox icon types as archetypes.
Saints, Madonna, Sacred Heart; Hindu murti and Buddha images have their own kinds elsewhere.
Domestic altarpieces and folding triptychs; museum old-master altarpieces belong to Art as paintings.

s.brief: Rosary archetypes (Dominican five-decade, Franciscan crown, tenner, chaplets of Divine Mercy and St Michael as types); Orthodox prayer rope (chotki/komboskini); medal archetypes (Miraculous Medal 1830, St Benedict medal, Scapular medal, St Christopher); brown and green scapulars; prie-dieu kneeler. Keep holy-water items plain.

k.brief: Orthodox chotki / komboskini, knotted wool.
Home prayer kneeler with armrest.

s.brief: Mostly parish goods: kind-level, no SKU models; keep antique/collector archetypes only where sourced (e.g. Gothic chalice forms, sunburst monstrance). Orthodox home lampada and hand censer (kadilo) are types of sanctuary lamp and censer. Dissolve the paschal candle into its own kind here only as parish item, no models.

k.brief: Christian chalice only; the kiddush cup is a new kind under Jewish.

depts.note: Ritual objects for the Sabbath, festivals, prayer and the home; designers and silversmiths in the brand register.

b.w: Comes first; rests on the scribe's reliability and rabbinical certification.

b.m: Fit to scroll, doorway and mounting (mezuzah case)

s.brief: Archetypes and makers: Hanukkah lamp forms (bench/wall Hanukkiah, candelabrum, oil), Bezalel School, Hazorfim, Yair Emanuel, Nambé, Michael Aram, Quest Collection; silver kiddush cups; Shabbat candlesticks; challah board and cover; seder plate forms; etrog box; Havdalah sets with spice towers (German tower form). Trim retail SKUs to archetype versions. Add tradition entries for Bezalel School and Eastern European silver Judaica.

Add tallit (Ashkenazi, Sephardi, Yemenite styles; tallit katan/tzitzit as type; tallit-and-tefillin bag as type) and ketubah (illuminated tradition, modern artist ketubot). Scroll goods: script styles (Beit Yosef, Ari, Alter Rebbe) as types; tefillin grades (peshutim, dakos, gassos). Shofar types (ram, Yemenite kudu). Torah finials (rimonim) and pointer as silver archetypes; Torah scroll kind-level.

depts.note: Objects for prayer, recitation and the home.

b.w: Uniform colour may mean treated or imitation.

s.brief: Add rehal (folding Qur'an stand; Moroccan/Indian carved, Turkish inlay), mabkhara (incense burner for bakhoor/oud; Gulf forms), Qur'an box and cover, qibla compass, Ramadan lantern (fanous, Egyptian tin-and-glass tradition), Islamic calligraphy wall panel. Prayer-rug archetypes by weaving tradition (Turkish seccade, Persian janamaz); tasbih materials (kuka, yusr, kahraman amber, Tesbih craft of Erzurum oltu stone) with traditions. Bakhoor and oud chips are a type under Ritual incense in the shared dept.

k.brief: Folding X-shaped Qur'an stand.
Footed incense burner for bakhoor and oud.
Fanous.
Framed Qur'anic or devotional calligraphy made for the home.

depts.note: Puja goods and articles of faith.

b.m: Right for the use and tradition (prayer beads)
b.v: 108 beads + guru bead; rudraksha, tulsi, sandalwood

s.brief: Add murti (deity image; archetypes by iconography: Ganesha, Lakshmi, Nataraja, Shiva lingam; traditions: Swamimalai bronze, Panchaloha, Jaipur marble), home mandir, puja thali, kalash, shankha, havan kund. Oil lamp: diya, aarti lamp, kuthuvilakku/samai, akhand diya as types; Nachiarkoil and Kerala bell-metal traditions. Mala: rudraksha, tulsi, sandalwood, crystal as types; Buddhist malas also here.

k.brief: Conch blown or used for offering.

s.brief: Sikh: articles of faith (kara, kirpan, kanga; kesh/dastar belong to Clothing) and items for the Guru Granth Sahib at home (rumala, chaur sahib, manji/palki sahib), Khanda emblem. Jain: home-shrine items such as siddhachakra yantra and Jain puja set, only if sourced. No new kind without a retrieved source.

k.brief: Canopied stand for the Guru Granth Sahib in a home or gurdwara.

depts.note: Japanese and East Asian home-altar goods and Tibetan / Himalayan ritual objects.

b.m: Form and style for the rite
b.v: butsudan mini, modern, karaki, kin; juzu by sect

b.w: Designated traditional crafts (e.g. Kyo-butsudan) rank on hand work.

s.brief: Butsudan by Japanese designated traditional-craft centre (Kyo-butsudan, Nagoya, Hikone, Kanazawa, Yamagata) as archetypes/traditions, plus modern furniture-style; Buddha image archetypes (Amida, Shakyamuni, Kannon, Medicine Buddha; Gandhara/Thai/Tibetan styles); juzu by sect (Jodo, Shingon, Nichiren, etc.); rin, mokugyo, ihai (kuridashi), kakocho. Trim Hasegawa ranges to a brand-register entry.

k.brief: Old 'Household altar' becomes the Buddhist butsudan; kamidana and home mandir are their own kinds.
Old 'Other prayer beads' catch-all dissolves: rosary, mala and tasbih have kinds; this keeps the juzu.

s.brief: Add phurba, khata, mandala offering set, tsa-tsa. Dorje (vajra) and drilbu bell as a pair; thangka schools (Menri, Karma Gadri, Newar) as traditions, kakejiku honzon as type; prayer wheels (hand, table, wall, water); lungta prayer flags; damaru (incl. chod drum), tingsha, kartika. Tradition entries for thangka painting and Newar metal casting (Patan).

k.brief: Old 'Ritual knife' keeps the Tibetan kartika; the Wiccan athame is a new kind under divination & witchcraft.
Ceremonial silk offering scarf.

depts.note: Shrine goods for the home and folk-religion objects of Japan and the Chinese world.

b.w: Ofuda and omamori are valued by the shrine that issues them, not by maker.

s.brief: Add kamidana (ichisha, sansha forms), ofuda (jingu taima), ema, omikuji. Omamori types by blessing; evil-eye charm and hamsa as types. Gohei, shimenawa, votive lanterns (bon chochin, toro) as is.

k.brief: Omamori first; evil-eye, hamsa and other folk charms as types.

s.brief: Add home ancestral/deity altar (shentoi), ancestral tablet, Daoist talisman (fu), joss paper (incl. hell bank notes), kau cim fortune sticks, jiaobei moon blocks, peach-wood sword, bagua mirror. Source each from a retrieved page.

k.brief: Shentoi / Chinese home altar cabinet.
Fu paper talisman.

depts.note: Ritual goods shared across traditions; variety at the incense-connoisseur end, tier for everyday candles.

b.v: natural agarwood, sandalwood, resins > synthetic fragrance
b.w: Connoisseur incense is judged on raw materials.
Liturgical candles are labelled by beeswax percentage.

s.brief: Incense makers as brand register (Shoyeido, Nippon Kodo, Baieido, Kyukyodo, Satya/Shrinivas, Mount Athos church incense); forms stick, cone, resin, bakhoor, smudge as types; kōdō tradition entry. Candles: merge the 'Other ritual candles' catch-all into one kind with altar, votive, vigil, 7-day, procession, grave candles as types. Offering vessels, stands, alms boxes and hand bells stay plain (types only).

k.brief: Sanctus bell, puja ghanta, drilbu as types.

depts.note: Decks are organised by pattern archetype (Marseille, Rider-Waite-Smith, Thoth) and publisher, never as flat title lists.

b.w: Readers choose a deck by the system its imagery follows.
Collectors value first editions, restorations and publisher.

s.brief: Tarot archetypes in order: Visconti-Sforza (15th c.), Tarot de Marseille (Grimaud/Conver/Camoin-Jodorowsky, CBD Ben-Dov as versions), Rider-Waite-Smith 1909 (Rider; US Games Systems; Smith-Waite Centennial; Pamela Colman Smith), Thoth (Crowley/Harris; AGM-Urania/US Games), Sola Busca, then modern independents (Wild Unknown etc.) as versions under their lineage. Publisher brand register: US Games Systems, Lo Scarabeo, Llewellyn, AGM-Urania, Grimaud, Hay House. Lenormand: Game of Hope / Petit Lenormand archetype. Oracle: maker-free, keep a few sourced versions.

Ouija archetype (Kennard Novelty 1890, William Fuld, Parker Brothers, Hasbro) on the spirit board; Elder Futhark / Younger Futhark rune sets; I Ching coins vs yarrow stalks; add athame (Wiccan ritual knife), altar pentacle and black scrying mirror only with retrieved sources.

depts.note: Bought once, under pressure: the right kind and what makes a good one, no catalogue SKUs.

b.v: solid wood · veneered board · steel gauge · wicker/cardboard (eco)
b.w: Qualities of the coffin, not a ranking.
A quality of the urn, not a ranking.
Size and material are often set by the cemetery.

s.brief: Restraint: replace Co-op Funeralcare and Memorials.com SKU lists with market-covering makers/retailers only (≈5–8 per kind, e.g. major casket makers such as Batesville, Matthews; eco makers; leading urn retailers) — source each. Coffin plate and coffin pillow become types of Coffin (fittings); scattering urn and urn plaque become types of Cremation urn (keepsake, companion, pet, scattering as types).
